basic_info.description: Victorian charm meets modern sophistication in this beautifully renovated top floor two bedroom, two bath, two car parking home with high end designer finishes throughout and thoughtful attention to every detail. No expense was spared in updating this gorgeous full floor flat :  bright open kitchen with Italian Marble Counters, stainless steel appliances and custom wood cabinets; New Primary Bath with Waterworks fixtures and tailored Dal Tile surround; new dual paned windows. All of the fit + finish have been lovingly executed to create a wonderfully elegant and elevated feel including  refined light fixtures and wall sconces, pretty Cole & Son wallpaper, and custom closet built-ins. Beyond the interior living level is an expansive walk out deck with partial city views, and big sky outlook, which sits over a serene, shared garden. The package of finishes and features is very hard to come by in one space - this condo includes two car parking (tandem with itself), in unit washer-dryer, and a 10' X 15' storage room perfect for home gym or extra office space.  The location of this sensational home keeps you firmly in the SF mix and just a short walk to Fillmore Street, The Presidio, and Japantown.
